section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining associations between Big Five personality domains and men's body image. A total of 509 men from the community in London, UK completed measures of drive for muscularity, body appreciation, Big Five domains, and subjective social status. Hierarchical regression results showed that Neuroticism significantly predicted drive for muscularity and body appreciation (negatively), while Extraversion positively predicted body appreciation.
